instruction: Candid cinematic film still, medium shot. On the right, the woman in the olive vest (R3) stands close, laughing with her arm draped over the shoulder of the woman in the black bucket hat (R2). The three women are huddled in a joyful embrace. Cool overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the scene, casting soft shadows in the dark concrete garage.
